structure.unit: Environmental Impact Reports of State Agencies

law.catch_line: Development of procedures, etc., for administration of chapter
law.text: The Department shall, in conjunction with other state agencies, coordinate the development of objectives, criteria and procedures to ensure the orderly preparation and evaluation of environmental impact reports required by this article. These procedures shall provide for submission of impact statements in sufficient time to permit any modification of the major state project which may be necessitated because of environmental impact.
